data.subject: Public-records research for Rhino
data.body:
Hi,

Rhino's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCB, RBB, and CFBK.

On September 24, 2026, PCB disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1423869/000142386926000029/pcb-20260923.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent, public-records-only research service. I can send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
